channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: yaojingang/GEOInflow: Self-hosted web and AI crawler analytics for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Track visitors, AI search…
item.description: GEOInflow is a self-hosted analytics tool that tracks website visitors, AI search referrals, and AI crawler activity for Generative Engine Optimization. It is MIT licensed and jointly published by 猎看科技 and 北京日报社智源GEO. Why it matters: Helps site owners see which AI crawlers visit their pages and how AI search contributes visitors and conversions.

item.title: ByteDance’s Zhang Yiming tops China rich list with US$99.7 billion as AI fuels fortunes
item.description: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming is China's richest person with US$99.7 billion, up 43%, according to the Hurun Research Institute, as ByteDance expanded aggressively into AI.

item.title: Man, 40, joins migrant workers for lunch at Woodlands void deck, they bond over family
item.description: Joshua Woo, 40, shared on Facebook how he joined three migrant workers for lunch at a Woodlands void deck, sparking praise online.

item.title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
item.description: Nvidia has backed Indian startup Simplismart in a $14 million Series B round, which values the four-year-old company at about $100 million. Its software automates much of the work of running AI models efficiently, in some cases with fewer GPUs. Why it matters: Shows investor interest in software that helps companies run AI models efficiently as computing capacity is strained.

item.title: Sterling Anderson doesn’t think humanoid robots should be building cars
item.description: General Motors' product chief Sterling Anderson explains the company's software evolution, multisensor vehicle safety, and argues personally owned autonomous vehicles beat robotaxis.

item.title: Nvidia is bankrolling AI accelerator supply chain buildout to reserve production capacity
item.description: Nvidia announced multi-billion-dollar deals at GTC Berlin to expand chip supply capacity through 2028, covering substrates, advanced packaging, testing and optical engines.

item.title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
item.description: Investor Jason Calacanis urged investors to sell bitcoin and move into AI, predicting bitcoin will fall to $57,000 within a year; he still holds TAO.

item.title: Xylem Non-GAAP EPS of $1.44 misses by $0.01, revenue of $2.2B misses by $80M, lowers FY guidance
item.description: Xylem reported non-GAAP EPS of $1.44, missing by $0.01, and revenue of $2.2 billion, missing by $80 million, and lowered full-year guidance.

item.title: Alliance Medinet says access path used in data breach has been secured
item.description: Alliance Healthcare Group says the access path used in a cyber incident at Alliance Medinet is secured, validated by KPMG; investigations continue.

item.title: Show me the money: Big Tech earnings put spotlight on AI spending
RSAF trials new tools at Exercise Wallaby that significantly speed up mission planning
item.description: RSAF trials at Exercise Wallaby cut flight-mission planning from two hours to 20 minutes and shorten air strike calls by 50% to 80%.

item.title: Apple's MacBook Pro Touch Bar Was Announced 10 Years Ago Today
item.description: Apple introduced the MacBook Pro Touch Bar 10 years ago, and the last Touch Bar model was discontinued in October 2023.

item.title: Risks Spelled Out for Anthropic Investors Include Possible Harms From Runaway AI
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing devotes 93 of its 335 pages to risk factors, including misuse of AI for deadly weapons and AI going rogue.

item.title: Evan Goldberg on AI trust: Confident answers aren’t enough, context is everything
item.description: Agency & ConsultingBig dataDefiE-CommerceHardwareRetailArtificial IntelligenceCryptocurrencyEducationHealthtechSoftware As A Service Tech Innovators secured $50 million in funding from Venture Capitalist Alpha, paving the way for groundbreaking advancements in artificial intelligence.

item.title: iPhone 18e Could Get Two Key Upgrades While Keeping 60Hz Display
item.description: A leaker says the iPhone 18e keeps a 60Hz display and single 48MP rear camera, with an A20 chip and possibly a 24MP front camera.

item.title: Apple backports CoreGraphics zero-day patches to older iPhones
item.description: Apple backported patches for CVE-2026-86950, a CoreGraphics out-of-bounds write zero-day exploited in targeted attacks, to older iPhones and iPads.

item.title: Anthropic S-1, The Cost of Compute, Who Is Paying?
item.description: Anthropic's IPO is here; its core business is very profitable, but competition may erode those profits, and investors are set up for endless dilution.

item.title: Singapore shares fall amid mixed regional showing; STI drops 0.3%
item.description: The Straits Times Index fell 0.3% to 5,397.03 on Tuesday, as regional markets were mixed and DBS slipped 0.4%.

item.title: The iOS-ification of Android is ruining my favorite phones
item.description: A writer is tired of Android copying Liquid Glass, while praising the OPPO Find X10 Pro Max's battery life, performance and camera.

item.title: 60,000 Microsoft employees offered voluntary buyouts as AI buildout costs bite
item.description: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to around 60,000 employees, about 27% of its 223,000 workforce, as it balances costs amid AI data center spending.

item.title: Roblox downloaded 145GB models from us (including adult content) without asking
item.description: A crawler claiming to be from Roblox downloaded 145.5 GB from 712 projects on three creator sites, likely for AI training.

item.title: UPS beats quarterly expectations, raises full-year guidance again
item.description: UPS beat third-quarter expectations and raised full-year revenue guidance to approximately $92.6 billion, up from $91.2 billion.

item.title: Sources: UK stealth AI startup 22one, which is building law enforcement tools, hit a nearly $400M valuation after raising funds from Sequoia, Lux, and others
item.description: UK stealth AI startup 22one, which builds tools for police forces, reportedly reached a nearly $400M valuation after raising funds from investors including Sequoia.

item.title: Who controls powerful AI? Anthropic has a plan for long after its leaders depart
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals a governance plan for who controls the company as its AI advances. Seven co-founders hold 50.1 per cent voting power over certain matters, while an independent trust controls a majority of board seats. Why it matters: Shows how a leading AI company has insulated its mission-driven governance from investor pressure as it heads toward a public listing.

item.title: Labubu loses its bite as Pop Mart’s quarterly sales plunge up to 50%
item.description: BEIJING – Pop Mart International Group reported a decline in third-quarter sales from a year earlier, hurt by fading Labubu momentum and a tough base of comparison following blockbuster results…

item.title: Malaysian who accessed 17 Singapore bank accounts for syndicate in S$4 million case gets jail
item.description: A Malaysian man who took a Facebook job for a syndicate was sentenced to eight months' jail for accessing 17 Singapore bank accounts.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for precise computer use
item.description: OpenAI has launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model with stronger visual reasoning, computer use, and lower API pricing.

item.title: Crypto blitzes midterms with $176 million to support allies as it prepares for post-Trump era
item.description: The crypto industry spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 midterm races, part of a plan to build a bipartisan coalition in Congress.

item.title: This is Fine: What NetScaler Zero-Days Tell Us About the New Normal
item.description: An article on the September 2026 Citrix NetScaler zero-day advisories, arguing that the episode shows active defense working as intended.

item.title: Big Tech earnings a test of the AI boom amid market turmoil
item.description: Wall Street expects Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet to report faster cloud growth, while a market selloff and concerns over AI financing costs temper optimism.

item.title: From federal SOCs to Talos: Ryan Fetterman on practical security research
item.description: In an interview, security researcher Ryan Fetterman discusses detection engineering, his path from federal agency work to Talos, and avoiding burnout in security careers.

item.title: Anthropic prepares for potential $2 trillion IPO valuation after reporting billions in revenue
item.description: Anthropic filed to go public at a valuation that could reach about $2 trillion, after reporting $16.3 billion in first-half 2026 revenue.

item.title: Seatrium, Karpowership to develop floating power, digital infrastructure solutions in Singapore
item.description: The companies may extend cooperation to the wider South-east Asia market [SINGAPORE] Mainboard-listed offshore and marine player Seatrium announced on Tuesday (Oct 27) a collaboration with global-energy company Karpowership to…

item.title: Will haze, sustainability, be on Singapore’s agenda as incoming ASEAN chair?
item.description: A podcast asks whether haze and sustainability will feature as Singapore takes the 2027 ASEAN chair, weighing economy against climate action.

item.title: Meta gets $3 billion from Nvidia and plans to spend more on Nvidia chips
item.description: Nvidia is investing $3 billion in Meta's planned equity offering, and Meta plans to run more of its AI agents on Nvidia hardware.

item.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says
item.description: Galaxy Digital says the bitcoin bear market ended in June and urges investors to accumulate, citing price trends, ETF demand and rising US debt.

item.title: Australia Gets Into Amadey Malware Backend, Cuts Off Access to 180,000 Infected Computers
item.description: Australian Signals Directorate says it gained access to the backend of the Amadey malware operation and cut it off from 180,000 infected computers worldwide.

item.title: Five listed directorships cap among proposed changes to corporate governance code, SGX rules
item.description: Singapore's CGAC and SGX RegCo propose changes to the corporate governance code and listing rules, including a cap that could limit directors to five directorships in Singapore-listed companies. Key board committees may need a majority of independent directors. Why it matters: Could affect board independence and how many listed boards each director can sit on, which bears on investor confidence.

item.title: I Tested Every Major AI Agent for a Day. Here’s the Best One
item.description: A WIRED reporter ranked six always-on AI agents on basic tasks, finding them more reliable than last year but still making mistakes.

item.title: Chairman’s role in spotlight with raft of proposed new rules for Singapore boards
item.description: Singapore regulators propose rules requiring a lead independent director where the chairman is not independent, and capping directors at five directorships.

item.title: Energy giant ENGIE discloses data breach affecting customers
item.description: ENGIE confirmed attackers stole customer data from a marketing platform used by business partners; it says its internal systems were not compromised.

item.title: Just In: Rokid Unveils Its First Full-Color AI Glasses, Starting at 4999 Yuan
item.description: Rokid launched Rokid Glasses 2, the full-color Rokid Color AI glasses, and the Rokid Ring smart ring, with pricing starting at 4999 yuan.

item.title: The Qode Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover…
item.description: CVE-2026-92885 (CVSS 9.8) lets unauthenticated attackers log in as any existing WordPress account, including administrators, via the Qode Membership plugin up to 2.0.6.2.

item.title: Istana open house to be held on Nov 1 ahead of Deepavali, subject to haze conditions
item.description: The Istana open house on Nov 1 runs 10am to 8pm, but will not proceed if the 24-hour PSI reaches the very unhealthy range.

item.title: Read Sea CEO’s full memo on Monee IPO and Sea Cloud launch
item.description: Sea has filed CEO Forrest Li's memo on a possible IPO for Monee and the launch of Sea Cloud, an AI-first enterprise platform.

item.title: Nvidia to invest $3b in Meta as AI partnership expands
item.description: Nvidia plans to invest $3 billion in Meta as the AI partnership expands. The two firms may work on Nvidia's OpenShell, including Sentry for monitoring agent behaviour. Why it matters: Signals deeper ties between Nvidia and Meta, with possible joint work on tools for monitoring AI agents.

item.title: Beyond the EV hype: Why the used-car industry is Europe’s untapped asset
item.description: Spotawheel lets customers buy, sell or subscribe to used cars across Central and Eastern Europe, where traditional banks don't offer auto loans.

item.title: OpenAI Compaction Flaw Let Researchers Bypass Hidden Reasoning Protections
item.description: Security firm Xint showed OpenAI's compaction feature could expose a model's hidden reasoning in plain text; OpenAI fixed it on October 23.

item.title: DoorDash in advanced talks to acquire Instacart for $17b
item.description: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire rival Instacart in a deal valuing Instacart at around $17 billion, though it is not guaranteed.

item.title: El tipo que creó Claude Code soltó un video de 28 minutos y es una locura
item.description: En los primeros 10 minutos ya te enseña más que cursos de 300 dólares Cómo usar CLAUDE.md, memoria, sesiones en paralelo y prompts que de verdad funcionan Sin relleno, sin…

item.title: Off Grid AI
item.description: Off Grid AI runs AI models on your own phone and computer with Wi-Fi off and no account, and is free and open source.

item.title: The MotionSites skill is live 🚀. I turned 700+ of my best website designs into one skill.
item.description: MotionSites is a free, open-source skill that packages 700+ website designs so AI agents can build animated, cinematic sites.

item.title: Thinking-in-Bets at Test Time Reduces Sycophantic Revisions in LLM Agents
item.description: The paper proposes Thinking-in-Bets, where an agent records its claims and checks before reading pushback, nearly eliminating false reversals in patch review.

item.title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance
item.description: A study finds constrained decoding's apparent performance drops mostly stem from prompt and output format differences, while validity constraints improve reliability and reasoning constraints can improve accuracy.

item.title: ZiChuanLan/agent-purge: One persona, many coding agents. Replace or inject system prompts across codex, claude, opencode, grok, omp…
item.description: agent-purge replaces or injects one persona's system prompt across many coding agents, such as Claude, Codex and OpenCode, through a local web console. It supports replace, append and off modes, and changes can be fully reversed. Why it matters: Gives AI agent users one place to manage system prompts across several coding agents.

item.title: Man, 43, allegedly hit police car, ran multiple traffic lights in Marina Bay, drove without licence, to be charged
item.description: A 43-year-old man will be charged for allegedly fleeing a police check, colliding with a police car, running red lights and driving without a licence.

item.title: Backbase Launches Delivery Factory with AI Agents for Banks
item.description: Backbase launched Delivery Factory, an AI-powered software development platform that lets banking delivery teams work alongside specialised AI agents. Backbase says teams using it delivered projects twice as fast as traditional teams. Why it matters: Shows AI agents moving into bank software development, a trend for AI and fintech readers.

item.title: European shares fall as HSBC weighs, France protests keep investors wary
item.description: European shares fell on Tuesday as HSBC's weaker-than-expected revenue weighed on banks and ongoing protests in France kept investors cautious.

item.title: BofA raises Talen Energy stock price target on acquisition benefits
Your Android phone may remember AI chats you thought you deleted
item.description: Researchers at Georgia Tech built a forensic tool that recovers deleted conversations from locally run AI apps on Android phones.
